claim_decisions.scope: A reused reference fixture plus one prespecified fresh confirmation fixture and one training run per arm per fixture. This is bounded replication of post-upgrade acquisition, not broad robustness across training seeds or task families.

paired_two_fixture_review.controls_and_fairness: Fresh task LoRA reaches 64/64 on both fixtures and exceeds native core by four and five cases respectively. Native core exceeds latent-only by 28 and 33 cases. Capacities differ (17,484,032 native versus 3,833,856 LoRA versus 256 latent); native core alone adds 96 old-A replay examples. The comparison does not establish efficiency or method superiority.

paired_two_fixture_review.uncertainty_boundary: Paired intervals resample 64 input triples within each fixture using that fixture seed. No pooled interval or between-fixture/training-seed uncertainty estimate is justified from these two selected fixtures.
